title: Bolting On a Few Personal Days
script: Yusuf: [thoughtful] If we fly out Thursday instead of Friday, we could squeeze in a couple of personal days before the conference even starts.
Sarah: That depends on whether the client's happy to have us there unsupervised for two extra days, which I honestly doubt.
Yusuf: [carefully] We wouldn't be unsupervised, we'd just be exploring the city, which is a fairly normal thing to do on a business trip.
Sarah: Normal for you, maybe. I've been told more than once that mixing leisure with work trips looks unprofessional to some managers.
Yusuf: [reflective] Provided we're clear about which days are annual leave, I don't see how anyone could reasonably object.
Sarah: Fair enough. Though if the flights get changed at the last minute, we'd be the ones absorbing the extra cost, not the company.
Yusuf: [honestly] True, that's a real risk. Though the fare difference is fairly small, given how far in advance we're booking.
Sarah: What would we even do with two spare days in a city neither of us has visited before?
Yusuf: [gently] I've read that the old quarter is best explored on foot, ideally before the summer crowds descend on it.
Sarah: That does sound appealing, especially since we'll otherwise be stuck in conference rooms for four straight days.
Yusuf: [calmly] Exactly. Once the conference starts, neither of us will have a spare moment to see anything beyond the hotel.
Sarah: Alright, let's request the extra leave, though I'd rather ask before booking than risk being refused afterwards.
Yusuf: [encouraging] Sensible. I'll draft the request tonight, and we can adjust the flights once it's been approved.
Sarah: Just don't schedule anything that requires early mornings. If I'm using leave, I intend to sleep in.
Yusuf: [seriously] Noted. Late starts, long walks, and absolutely no spreadsheets until Monday.
Sarah: Now that's a trip I'd actually look forward to, rather than merely tolerate.
Yusuf: Then it's settled. I'll send the request first thing tomorrow, before anyone changes their mind.
Sarah: Deal. Let's just hope the client doesn't reschedule the whole conference on us again.

quiz.question: What does Yusuf propose about the flight schedule?
options: Flying home a day early
Cancelling the conference trip
Booking a different airline
Flying out Thursday instead of Friday to add two personal days
quiz.explanation: Yusuf suggests flying out Thursday instead of Friday to fit in a couple of personal days before the conference.

quiz.question: Why is Sarah initially hesitant about the plan?
options: She dislikes the destination
She worries mixing leisure with work trips looks unprofessional to some managers
She cannot afford the extra days
She has another trip planned
quiz.explanation: Sarah says she has been told that mixing leisure with work trips can look unprofessional to some managers.

quiz.question: What financial risk does Sarah point out?
options: If flights change last minute, they would absorb the extra cost themselves
The hotel might be overbooked
The conference fee might increase
The company might cancel the trip
quiz.explanation: Sarah notes that if the flights are changed at the last minute, they would be the ones covering the extra cost, not the company.

quiz.question: What do they decide to do about requesting the extra days?
options: Book the flights first, then ask permission
Request the extra leave before booking, to avoid being refused afterwards
Not ask at all
Ask a colleague to request it for them
quiz.explanation: Sarah suggests asking for the extra leave before booking, rather than risking a refusal after booking.

quiz.question: What condition does Sarah set for the personal days?
options: No sightseeing allowed
Only visiting museums
No early mornings, since she wants to sleep in
Working half days
quiz.explanation: Sarah says not to schedule anything requiring early mornings, since she intends to sleep in during her leave.

quiz.question: What condition makes adding personal days professionally acceptable?
options: I booked this room three months ago and paid in full
Within months, that single photograph had been shared thousands of times
My guest today has visited over ninety countries
Annual leave and business expenses must remain clearly separated.
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: Annual leave and business expenses must remain clearly separated.

quiz.question: Which financial risk do the colleagues acknowledge before changing flights?
options: I can have the driver waiting within ten minutes
A fisherman I'd spoken to years earlier recognised me
A later return could create extra fare costs.
I realised I could describe fifteen airports in vivid detail
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: A later return could create extra fare costs.

quiz.question: Why do two leisure days appeal after the conference?
options: The work schedule otherwise leaves no time beyond the hotel.
Provided the room tomorrow is actually available, unlike tonight's, I suppose that works
I asked him whether he wished I'd never taken the picture
Fewer destinations per trip, for a start
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: The work schedule otherwise leaves no time beyond the hotel.

quiz.question: What approval will they obtain before making bookings?
options: I'll text you the confirmation and the driver's details right away
They will request the additional leave before changing flights.
I still photograph places I love
Missing something is preferable to remembering nothing clearly
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: They will request the additional leave before changing flights.

quiz.question: Which boundary marks the personal portion of the trip?
options: No spreadsheets or compulsory early starts during leave.
I'd rather trust you than the booking system, honestly
The village will keep changing regardless of what I do
Thank you for joining us today
quiz.explanation: This matches the audio: No spreadsheets or compulsory early starts during leave.
